Corruption is so deeply rooted in the South Carolina justice system. Child predators like Donald Gresh are being let out of jail after ONE day.

One day when he was facing a 60-year sentence.

This man had over 1,900 images of children. Toddlers as young as three years old being r*ped by animals. And the system cut him loose after a single day behind bars.

This is not a mistake. This is corruption. And it is putting our children at risk.

Every parent in South Carolina should be furious. We are

If you have allegiance to another country, you do not get to run ours.

We just introduced a constitutional amendment to make sure of it. No dual citizenship. No foreign allegiance. No one who holds loyalty to another country may serve in Congress, on the federal bench, as an Ambassador, or as President or Vice President of the United States. Unless they formally and permanently relinquish every last tie to the foreign country they came from first.

The people making our laws, commanding our mil

We supported the largest tax cuts in American history. We have never voted to raise your taxes. 

Your money belongs in YOUR wallet, and we haven't forgotten it. 

South Carolina STRONG.

One country. One allegiance. One loyalty.

America First.

The most important title I have is mom. 

Above anything else, my kids, and your kids, are the reason I work so hard. 

South Carolina is their home, and I’m going to make sure it’s worthy of them. 

South Carolina STRONG.

We have introduced TWO Constitutional Amendments to make sure our government officials are loyal to America and America ONLY. 

No foreign-born citizens serving in Congress or as federal judges. No dual citizens serving in our government. 

If you are going to make the laws of this country, your loyalty belongs to this country and this country alone. 

America FIRST.

MACE WIN: We secured EIGHT provisions in the FY27 NDAA base text. Here is what we delivered for our military and for South Carolina:

◼️ Eastern Regional Range Complex Demonstration Project 
◼️ Skills-based hiring for DoD civilian positions 
◼️ Skills-based requirements for DoD contractor personnel 
◼️ Stronger protections against revenge porn under the UCMJ 
◼️ Secure, mobile personal health records for servicemembers 
◼️ Tricare Select coverage expanded for pregnant servicewomen 
◼️ Advance pr

If being a natural-born citizen is good enough for the President, it is good enough for the rest of our government. Anyone with allegiance to another country should not be making decisions for ours. 

End of story.

Video

South Carolina’s seniors will never be forgotten on our watch.

They earned every benefit they receive and built the foundation of the country we live in today.

We work for them in Washington every single day and we will ALWAYS stand up for them.

No one works harder to expose corruption in Congress and bring taxpayers real transparency.

We introduced a resolution to expose Congress's sexual harassment and misconduct records, every single one. The names, the cases, the details they've been burying behind closed doors for years.

Both parties teamed up to kill it. Protecting themselves. Protecting their friends.

We didn't stop there. We moved to subpoena the sexual harassment slush fund records, the ones showing exactly how much of your

Every year, an estimated 250,000 to 320,000 babies are born on U.S. soil to illegal immigrant mothers, each one instantly eligible for a full range of federal benefits. Each one is a potential anchor for parents and extended family members to obtain legal status down the line. 

Reports estimate illegal immigrants and their U.S.-born children impose a net annual cost of $150.6 billion on American taxpayers, a number rising each year.

The girl who walked into The Citadel and refused to quit, no matter what was thrown at her, is still inside of me.

I was the first woman to graduate from one of the most demanding military colleges in the country. They did not make it easy. But I did not leave.

I will not quit. I will not back down. I never have.

PASS THE SAVE AMERICA ACT.

Illegals should not be voting in our elections. Not now. Not ever.

Video

South Carolina's military installations are the backbone of our national defense, and the FY27 NDAA base text reflects our commitment to keeping them strong.

We secured hundreds of millions for Joint Base Charleston, extended critical funding for MCRD Parris Island, restored services at Naval Hospital Beaufort, and directed more than $35 million to the University of South Carolina for cutting-edge defense research.
